items.title: Tools and Platforms for Real-Time Collaboration

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Tools and Platforms for Real-Time Collaboration under 9.3 as printed (PDF 129, printed 125).

blocks.text: Real-time collaboration tools allow multiple users to work on the same project at the same time. Platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom make sharing documents, chatting, and meeting online easier. These tools help teams organize tasks, edit files together, and stay updated instantly. Real-time collaboration saves time and reduces errors by keeping everyone aligned. Using these platforms efficiently helps teams work faster and more effectively in digital settings.
